import tomlkit

def test_rewrite_adds_extra_whitespace_line():
    initial_toml = '''# xxx test


[env.pro1.rst]
    name = "x7"

[env2]
    name = 2

[env3]
    name = 3
'''

    # Expected TOML after modification, without the bug's extra newline
    # The bug adds a newline after 'name = "x8"'
    expected_toml = '''# xxx test


[env.pro1.rst]
    name = "x8"

[env2]
    name = 2

[env3]
    name = 3
'''

    doc = tomlkit.parse(initial_toml)

    # Modify a value to trigger the rewrite logic
    doc["env"]["pro1"]["rst"]["name"] = "x8"

    actual_toml = tomlkit.dumps(doc)

    assert actual_toml == expected_toml
